summary: The trace shows the agent wrote custom simulation code from scratch instead of using queue_simulator.py, because the script was hardcoded for SOC headers and parameters. This patch refactors queue_simulator.py to be fully domain-configurable via CONFIG (headers, capacities, overtime, thresholds, row indices), and updates SKILL.md to reinforce the 'modify CONFIG only' rule with a domain adaptation guide. This prevents future agents from reinventing the simulation wheel.
